answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2359 Country: India Title: Can women having periods during the month of Ramadan, fast? Question: Can women having periods during the month of Ramadan, fast? Answer ID: 2359 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1298/1158=B) No, the fast will not be valid in a state of menstruation period. They have to make up the missed fasts later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
